body: Investigation found the bug was systemic: 58 of 109 live guidance articles were fabricated from securities-litigation-solicitation press releases (SueWallSt, Pomerantz, Levi & Korsinsky, Robbins Geller, Wolf Haldenstein, Hagens Berman, Gross Law Firm, DJS Law Group) that mention a real ticker while soliciting plaintiffs against it -- the trigger-word extractor had no way to distinguish these from genuine guidance. Added isLitigationAlertHeadline (phrase-matched pre-extraction filter, validated against the full 9625-headline var/prwatch corpus, ~12% flagged with no real release caught) and reHeadlineTimePrefix (strips a scrape-artifact timestamp prefix that garbled every extracted issuer name). Regenerated var/guidance/articles.ndjson through the fixed pipeline: 109 -> 47 records, zero spam terms remain. Rebuilt and restarted fatbaby-guidance-watcher.service; verified live on news.okemily.com/section/guidance. Commits 17b69a2, a01076f.
title: S170-07: guidance-watcher issuer-attribution bug — much bigger than one record
